Checked by food across the commodity, recipe-commodity and board namespaces for potato spellings: nothing prices creamers. If the 2026-08-26 'baby potatoes' ruling already minted this id, this is a REUSE, not a new mint.

registrar_rulings.reason: Not priced anywhere: no baby-potatoes cell in smp-feed.json, no row in commodities.json, recipe-commodities.json, or the recipe-board baseline, and recipe-floor-id-map.json only maps 'potato'->russet-potatoes. The estate has already ruled creamers a distinct purchase: yukon-gold-potatoes EXCLUDES \bbaby\b, petite, fingerling, creamer\s+potato, medley (commodities.json ~57798-57805), deliberately carving this SKU out rather than pricing it, and russet/red/sweet/canned/instant potato ids are different foods or forms (bulk loose vs 1.5-3 lb bagged creamer at a different $/lb). This exact id was already APPROVED 2026-08-26 (gold:6aa33b938c606025c0ad, run hunt-2026-08-26-ten, staple namespace; also in ingredient-resolutions.json) but never landed in any namespace or the feed - so this ruling is a REUSE of that decision converging on the same spelling, not a second mint, and there is no sibling in this batch to collide with. Follow-ups the caller must make: (1) mint baby-potatoes in commodities.json (weekly staples + capture worklist), unit lb, include patterns like baby\s+potato(?:es)?, little\s+potato(?:es)?, creamer\s+potato(?:es)?, petite\s+(?:red|gold|medley)?\s*potato, potato\s+medley, honey\s+gold, with a full ~150-pattern exclude list cloned from a potato neighbor plus sweet\s+potato, fingerling-only-if-distinct, canned, frozen, instant, mashed, salad, seasoned, microwave-meal brands; (2) red-potatoes currently lacks the \bbaby\b/petite/creamer excludes yukon-gold has, so 'Baby Red Potatoes' bags would double-claim - add those three excludes to red-potatoes via add-commodity-rule.ps1; (3) add commodity-dupe-allowlist.json pairs baby-potatoes<->red-potatoes and baby-potatoes<->yukon-gold-potatoes, reason 'bagged creamer SKU vs bulk loose, different purchase per 2026-08-26 ruling', so audit-commodity-dupes.ps1 never pages Brad on them. Vocabulary is a separate question: 'Little Potatoes' resolves to the existing baby-potatoes row already in ingredient-resolutions.json - no new name row needed.
